newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: AMMB Holdings merchant bank profits up.
newsitem.headline: AMMB Holdings merchant bank profits up.

text.p: AMMB Holdings Bhd said on Tuesday that pretax profits at its merchant bank rose 30.7 percent for the six months ended in September 1996 compared with the similar year-ago period.

The financial services group earlier today reported that pretax profits gained 43.69 percent to 433.39 million ringgit for the half-year and that net profits rose 48.97 percent to 242.66 million ringgit.
AMMB Holdings said the merchant bank performance was accompanied by a 37.6 percent rise in lending assets and improvements in fee-based and trading activities.
Commercial bank pretax profits grew by over 120 percent to 29.51 million ringgit during the first half of the year "due to the strong growth in its assets", AMMB said in a statement.
The stockbroking company saw its pretax profit increase to 81.60 million ringgit from 31.94 million ringgit during the six months, in line with the stock market's performance.
Over the period, Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange volume increased by over 80 percent, AMMB said.
AMMB's finance company recorded a 22.5 percent growth in lending activities and a pretax profit rise of 25.4 percent during the first half.

"The operating environment is expected to remain relatively unchanged in the second half of the financial year and the group therefore expects to continue its improved performance," AMMB said in its statement.
